title: fMRI software package (tool) registry entry
description: One YAML per software package under kb/tools/. A package ships programs; the realignment block names the one program the package supplies for between-volume realignment, with a citable source.

tool_id.description: Stable lower-case identifier; also the bare name token the fallback matches (e.g. 'spm' matches 'SPM12').

aliases.description: Spellings that name this package, matched whole after normalization; a trailing version token is stripped first for version_token packages.

version_token.description: True when the version is part of the name token as written (SPM8, SPM12); false when a digit run after the name is a citation artefact of the text layer.

program.description: The realignment program this package supplies, as it is named in its documentation.

source.description: Citation: the paper that documents the program, and/or the package's documentation.
